pair.hvac_exists: The HVAC Controller has already been added. One is enough for the whole home.

members.subtitle_select: Pick the devices this zone uses, room by room. A device can be both controlled and a sensor.
members.name: Zone name
members.subtitle_configure: Step: the setpoint step the device really accepts. Eco: lower setpoint or fan mode for air conditioners. Inverted: for relays where off means heating.
members.error_no_control: Choose at least one thermostat, air conditioner or relay to control.
members.error_relay_sensor: A zone with relays needs at least one temperature sensor.

error.invalid_time: Enter the time as HH:mm, for example 15:00
error.date_in_past: The last day of the long absence is already in the past
error.no_cooling: This zone has no cooling. Turn on Has cooling in the zone settings.

price.hourly_fallback: Rate is highest needs 15-minute prices, using above average
price.peak: Expensive: __price__ is a short price peak (threshold __threshold__)
price.not_peak: Normal: __price__ is not a short price peak (threshold __threshold__)
price.above_average: Expensive: __price__ is more than __pct__ % above today's average __average__
price.not_above_average: Normal: __price__ is not more than __pct__ % above today's average __average__

import.rejected: Prices rejected, kept the previous ones: __day__ prices __detail__
import.not_array: are not a list of prices
import.not_numeric: contain values that are not numbers
import.wrong_resolution: have __count__ values, which fits __other__-minute prices, but the price resolution is __resolution__ minutes. Check the price resolution setting
import.too_many: have __count__ values, more than the __slots__ slots of that day
import.today_incomplete: have __count__ values, but today needs all __slots__

zone.controller_last: HVAC Controller missing, using its last known state
zone.controller_fallback: HVAC Controller missing for over an hour: comfort without price control
zone.manual: Manual: the app does not write to the members
zone.setback_zero: setback is 0, so eco equals comfort
zone.no_cooling: Cooling season, but this zone has no cooling: members off
zone.long_absence_cooling: Long absence: no cooling, members off

member.no_step_in_band: no __step__ °C step fits the comfort range, keeping comfort
member.clamped_min: __value__ °C is below the device minimum, writing __min__ °C
member.clamped_max: __value__ °C is above the device maximum, writing __max__ °C
member.invalid: invalid setpoint __value__, kept the last good value
member.hold: waiting for the minimum hold time before writing __value__ °C
member.hand_wait: changed by hand, restoring __value__ °C after the hold time
member.hand_restored: changed by hand to __value__ °C, restored to __written__ °C
member.no_temperature: no temperature from an available sensor, relay kept off
